Builds **both** rank plots in one knit:

| set | what is plotted |
|---|---|
| `all` | every accession with a candidate row, passing or not. Non-passing drawn as small open grey circles, so the separation between signal and background is visible (this is what `rank_plot_v7` showed) |
| `passing` | only accessions with ≥1 site passing every v7.3 gate in ≥ `MIN_REPS` replicates (286 accessions / 391 sites) |

For each set it writes a PDF, an SVG, a standalone interactive HTML and a CSV, and embeds the interactive
version in this document. Hovering a point gives organism, accession, family, species, CM class, how many
of that accession's candidate positions passed the gates, and −log10 p of its strongest one.

**Reading the hover line "N of M candidate positions passed all gates":** M is how many rows that accession
has in `peaks_annotated.csv` — one row per candidate tile × stall position, *not* one per published site —
and N is how many of those cleared every v7.3 gate (treated SF ≥ 0.3, ctrl_sf ≤ 0.1, fold_change ≥ 3,
stall_reads ≥ 10, q ≤ 0.01) in ≥ `MIN_REPS` replicates. So `0 of 2` means the accession had two candidate
positions and neither passed; those are the small open grey circles, present only in the `all` set. In the
`passing` set every accession has N ≥ 1 by construction.

Accessions listed in `HIGHLIGHT` get a labelled callout in the static outputs. Set
`RING_HIGHLIGHTS <- TRUE` to also draw a ring around them — off by default, because the ring is larger than
the CM dots and hides them.

Point sizing is deliberate: CM-hit points are drawn **last** and largest (`SZ_CM`), passing no-hit points
smaller (`SZ_NOHIT`), non-passing smallest and faded (`SZ_NONPASS`, `A_NONPASS`). In the `all` set the greys
outnumber the coloured points roughly 4:1, so equal sizes or a single combined layer bury them.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(svglite)
library(plotly)        # install.packages("plotly") if missing
library(htmlwidgets)
library(glue)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Config

```{r config}
INPUT_DIR <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/inputs/20261019_rerun_viromelib_ordered"

SITES_CSV <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "261019_re-run_viromelib_orderedRef_orderedRef.sites_final.csv")
PEAKS_CSV <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "peaks_annotated.csv")
TAX_CSV   <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "virus_taxonomy_261019.csv")

OUTDIR <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/rank/20261019"
dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MIN_REPS     <- 2      # gate used to mark/filter passing accessions
TOP_N_LABELS <- 0      # also label the strongest N accessions (0 = highlights only)
RING_HIGHLIGHTS <- FALSE  # draw a dark ring around highlighted points (label already marks them)

# point sizes: CM-hit dots sit on top and are deliberately the largest, because in the
# "all" set they are a few hundred points among ~1,200 greys
SZ_NONPASS <- 0.8      # open grey, no site passing the gates
SZ_NOHIT   <- 1.3      # passing, no CM match
SZ_CM      <- 3.0      # passing, CM match
A_NONPASS  <- 0.35
RANK_ON      <- "auto" # "auto" (meta_pvalue if present, else meta_qvalue), "meta_pvalue", "meta_qvalue"
FIG_W <- 10
FIG_H <- 8

# ── Accessions to call out. Add or remove rows freely; the name shown is yours,
#    not the record's, so it can be the short form used in the text.
HIGHLIGHT <- tribble(
  ~accession,      ~highlight_name,
  "NC_015843.2",   "Tembusu virus",
  "NC_012532.1",   "Zika virus",
  "NC_024077.1",   "SbCNV-5",
  # NCBI merged Mogiana tick virus into the Jingmen tick virus node (TaxID 1172985,
  # species Jingmenvirus rhipicephali) between the Mar 2025 design and the 2026 taxonomy.
  # The 2025 GenBank record reads "Mogiana tick virus isolate MGTV/V4/11 segment 3"; the
  # current name is Jingmen tick virus. Label with the current name so the rank plot and the
  # IGV panels agree, and keep the isolate, which is what the record is actually of.
  "NC_034223.1",   "Jingmen tick virus (MGTV/V4/11)"
)

CM_COLS <- c(
  class1a = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class1b = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class2  = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class3  = "cl3_NAR_2025.align.mpkadded.edited.confident.dedup.IDcurated.SS_cons.cm_hit",
  class4  = "cl4.cm_hit"
)
cm_colors <- c(class1a = "#B5179E", class1b = "#7209B7", class2 = "#3A0CA3",
               class3 = "#1B998B", class4 = "#136F63", no_hit = "#CCCCCC")
cm_labels <- c(class1a = "Class 1a", class1b = "Class 1b", class2 = "Class 2",
               class3 = "Class 3", class4 = "Class 4", no_hit = "No hit")
# `<model>.cm_hit` holds the cmsearch E-VALUE, not a flag. A site takes the model with the LOWEST
# E-value among those hitting it -- the most confident call -- never a hand-set priority order,
# which would settle a disagreement between two models by fiat and hide that it happened.
# Measured 2026-10-21 on the 5-CM annotation: 0 of 391 sites are hit by more than one model, so
# the tie-break is currently inert. It will matter once viromelib is re-annotated with the seven
# settled CMs (decision 25), since class1c is a subclass of class 1 and may hit class-1 sites.
cm_order_for_display <- c("class1a", "class1b", "class2", "class3", "class4")
```

## Load, collapse, plot — one function, run for both sets

```{r build_fn}
load_set <- function(rank_set) {
  stopifnot(rank_set %in% c("all", "passing"))

  if (rank_set == "passing") {
    d <- read_csv(SITES_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
    d$passed <- TRUE
  } else {
    # raw annotated table: every candidate row. No `organism` column (added later by
    # apply_publication_cutoffs.py --snapshot-manifest) and no plain_accession, so derive both.
    d <- read_csv(PEAKS_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(plain_accession = str_extract(accession, "^[^|]+"),
             passed = !is.na(n_reps_passing) & as.integer(n_reps_passing) >= MIN_REPS)
    tax <- read_csv(TAX_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(plain_accession = accession, organism, species_tax = species)
    d <- d %>% left_join(tax, by = "plain_accession") %>%
      mutate(species = if ("species" %in% names(.)) coalesce(species, species_tax) else species_tax)
  }

  pcol <- if (RANK_ON != "auto") RANK_ON
          else if ("meta_pvalue" %in% names(d)) "meta_pvalue" else "meta_qvalue"
  stopifnot("chosen RANK_ON column is not in the file" = pcol %in% names(d))

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      organism = if ("organism" %in% names(.)) organism else NA_character_,
      species  = if ("species"  %in% names(.)) species  else NA_character_,
      family   = ifelse(is.na(family) | family %in% c("", "nan"), "Unknown", family),
      pval     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[pcol]])),
      log10p   = -log10(pmax(pval, 1e-300))
    )

  # E-value per model, NA where the model did not hit this row
  ev <- sapply(names(CM_COLS), function(k) {
    col <- CM_COLS[[k]]
    if (col %in% names(d)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d[[col]])))
    else rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
  })
  ev <- matrix(ev, nrow = nrow(d), dimnames = list(NULL, names(CM_COLS)))

  d$cm_n_hits <- rowSums(!is.na(ev))
  d$cm_class  <- apply(ev, 1, function(r)
    if (all(is.na(r))) "no_hit" else names(r)[which.min(r)])        # lowest E-value wins
  d$cm_evalue <- apply(ev, 1, function(r) if (all(is.na(r))) NA_real_ else min(r, na.rm = TRUE))
  d$cm_all    <- apply(ev, 1, function(r) {
    h <- names(r)[!is.na(r)]
    if (!length(h)) "" else paste0(cm_labels[h], " (E=", signif(r[h], 2), ")", collapse = "; ")
  })
  if (any(d$cm_n_hits > 1))
    message(glue("  {sum(d$cm_n_hits > 1)} row(s) hit by more than one CM; ",
                 "assigned the lowest-E-value model, all listed in cm_all"))

  ranked <- d %>%
    group_by(plain_accession) %>%
    summarise(
      organism    = first(na.omit(organism)),
      species     = first(na.omit(species)),
      family      = first(family),
      n_rows      = n(),
      n_passing   = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_log10p = max(log10p, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_feature= accession[which.max(log10p)],
      # the accession is coloured by the CM of its OWN strongest site, so colour and
      # y-position describe the same stall
      cm_class        = cm_class[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_evalue       = cm_evalue[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_all          = cm_all[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_multi_hit    = any(cm_n_hits > 1),
      n_sites_with_cm = sum(cm_n_hits > 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(accession = plain_accession) %>%
    left_join(HIGHLIGHT, by = "accession") %>%
    mutate(passed_any = n_passing > 0,
           label_name = coalesce(highlight_name, organism)) %>%
    arrange(desc(best_log10p)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(),
           frac_rank = (rank - 1) / max(n() - 1, 1),
           cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = names(cm_colors)),
           tip = glue("{coalesce(organism, '(no organism name)')}\n",
                      "{accession}  |  rank {rank}\n",
                      "{family}  |  {coalesce(species, 'NA')}\n",
                      "CM at the strongest site: {ifelse(cm_all == '', 'none', cm_all)}\n",
                      "sites with a CM hit: {n_sites_with_cm} of {n_rows}\n",
                      "{n_passing} of {n_rows} candidate positions passed all gates in >={MIN_REPS} reps\n",
                      "strongest: -log10 {pcol} = {round(best_log10p, 2)}"))

  list(data = ranked, pcol = pcol, rank_set = rank_set)
}

static_plot <- function(S) {
  d <- S$data; pcol <- S$pcol; rank_set <- S$rank_set
  y_max <- max(d$best_log10p, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08
  label_df <- d %>%
    filter(!is.na(highlight_name) | (TOP_N_LABELS > 0 & rank <= TOP_N_LABELS)) %>%
    mutate(label_text = paste0(label_name, "\n", accession))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = frac_rank, y = best_log10p)) +
    # layer order matters: greys first, CM hits last so they are never covered
    geom_point(data = filter(d, !passed_any),
               colour = "grey82", size = SZ_NONPASS, alpha = A_NONPASS, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class == "no_hit"),
               colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = SZ_NOHIT, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class != "no_hit"),
               aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = SZ_CM, alpha = 1,
               colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.25) +
    {if (RING_HIGHLIGHTS)
       geom_point(data = label_df, shape = 21, size = SZ_CM + 1.6, stroke = 0.5,
                  colour = "grey35", fill = NA)
     else NULL} +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, labels = cm_labels, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = label_df, aes(label = label_text),
      colour = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3.3,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.78), label.size = 0.25,
      label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"), box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"), max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0, segment.colour = "grey40", segment.size = 0.4,
      direction = "y", nudge_x = 0.10, hjust = 0, force = 6, seed = 42,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = glue("Rank plot ({rank_set}) — {nrow(d)} accessions, ",
                   "{sum(d$passed_any)} stall-positive"),
      subtitle = glue("ranked on {pcol} of the strongest site per genome; ",
                      "{if (rank_set == 'all') 'open grey = no site passing the gates' else 'passing accessions only'}"),
      x = "Fractional rank (0 = strongest)",
      y = if (pcol == "meta_pvalue") expression(-log[10](p[meta])) else expression(-log[10](q[meta]))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.02, 1.02), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#F0F0F0", linewidth = 0.3))
}

interactive_plot <- function(S) {
  d <- S$data; pcol <- S$pcol
  # plotly cannot render ggrepel labels, so the interactive version carries the
  # information in the tooltip instead and rings the highlights.
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = frac_rank, y = best_log10p, text = tip)) +
    # same layer order as the static plot: a single `passed_any` layer would let a grey
    # no_hit point draw over a CM point, since plotly honours data order within a layer
    geom_point(data = filter(d, !passed_any),
               colour = "grey82", size = SZ_NONPASS + 0.2, alpha = A_NONPASS, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class == "no_hit"),
               colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = SZ_NOHIT + 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class != "no_hit"),
               aes(colour = cm_class), size = SZ_CM - 0.4, alpha = 1) +
    {if (RING_HIGHLIGHTS)
       geom_point(data = filter(d, !is.na(highlight_name)),
                  shape = 21, size = SZ_CM + 1.2, stroke = 0.7, colour = "grey35", fill = NA)
     else NULL} +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cm_colors, labels = cm_labels, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Fractional rank (0 = strongest)",
         y = glue("-log10 {pcol}"),
         title = glue("Rank plot ({S$rank_set}) — hover for organism and accession")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(hoverlabel = list(align = "left", font = list(size = 11)))
}
```

```{r build_both, results='asis'}
SETS <- lapply(c("all", "passing"), load_set)
names(SETS) <- c("all", "passing")

widgets <- list()
for (nm in names(SETS)) {
  S <- SETS[[nm]]
  d <- S$data
  message(glue("[{nm}] {nrow(d)} accessions | {sum(d$n_rows)} rows | ",
               "{sum(d$passed_any)} stall-positive | ranked on {S$pcol}"))
  message(glue("[{nm}] highlights matched: {sum(!is.na(d$highlight_name))} of {nrow(HIGHLIGHT)}"))
  if (any(is.na(d$organism)))
    message(glue("[{nm}] WARNING {sum(is.na(d$organism))} accessions without an organism name"))

  p <- static_plot(S)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, glue("rank_{nm}.pdf")), p, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, glue("rank_{nm}.svg")), p, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H)
  write_csv(d %>% select(-tip), file.path(OUTDIR, glue("rank_table_{nm}.csv")))

  w <- interactive_plot(S)
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(w, file.path(path.expand(OUTDIR), glue("rank_{nm}.html")),
                          selfcontained = TRUE, title = glue("viromelib rank plot ({nm})"))
  widgets[[nm]] <- w
  message(glue("[{nm}] -> rank_{nm}.pdf / .svg / .html / rank_table_{nm}.csv"))
}
```

  filter(!is.na(highlight_name)) %>%
  select(highlight_name, accession, organism, family, species, rank,
         best_log10p, n_passing, n_rows, cm_class) %>%
